option_relations.rationale: Cholangiocarcinoma is a cancer of the bile ducts. The leaf specifies pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, which is a different primary cancer, although both can cause obstructive jaundice.

This option specifies 'Extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma' as the primary cancer, whereas the leaf specifies 'Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (head)'. While both involve paraneoplastic myositis, the primary cancer type differs.

This option specifies 'Distal cholangiocarcinoma (biliary adenocarcinoma)', which is a bile duct cancer. The leaf specifies 'Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (head)', a different primary cancer, even though both are adenocarcinomas and can present similarly.

The leaf includes 'paraneoplastic myositis with rhabdomyolysis', which is a type of paraneoplastic (immune-mediated) necrotizing myopathy. This option describes a component of the overall diagnosis in the leaf.
